section.title: Quoting a currency conversion
section.scenario: A small business dashboard shows what an invoice would come to in the customer's currency, labeled as an estimate. The rate provider publishes one rate per currency pair each day at midnight UTC, and it does not change during the day. Its current plan allows 1,000 calls a day, the dashboard makes about 150 conversions on a busy day, and each call returns in under 100 ms. Nobody has reported the dashboard as slow.
section.question: Both pieces give the same estimate. Which cost should this system pay, and which stated facts decide it?
